command:
set -eo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
cd /tmp
echo "== do the long reads support GIAB's known variants where they were placed? =="
# Truth SNVs inside the high-confidence BED, normalised the same way every other caller page uses.
bcftools view -R truth.chr20.bed -v snps -i 'GT="alt"' -Ou truth.chr20.vcf.gz \
  | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o t.snv.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f t.snv.vcf.gz
bcftools view -H t.snv.vcf.gz | awk '{print $1"\t"$2}' > pos.tsv
NTRUTH=$(wc -l < pos.tsv)
echo "truth SNV sites: $NTRUTH"
# Genotype ONLY at those sites. This measures whether the alignment puts the right reads in the
# right place -- recall at known sites -- and is deliberately NOT a variant-calling benchmark:
# precision is not meaningful when you only look where the answer already is.
T0=$(date +%s)
bcftools mpileup -f chr20.fa -T pos.tsv -q 20 -Ou hifi.sorted.bam 2> mp.log \
  | bcftools call -m -Oz -o q.vcf.gz
T1=$(date +%s)
bcftools index -f q.vcf.gz
bcftools view -v snps -i 'GT="alt"' -Ou q.vcf.gz | bcftools norm -f chr20.fa -m -any -Oz -o q.snv.vcf.gz
bcftools index -f q.snv.vcf.gz
rm -rf is; bcftools isec -p is q.snv.vcf.gz t.snv.vcf.gz
TP=$(grep -vc '^#' is/0002.vcf || true)
FN=$(grep -vc '^#' is/0001.vcf || true)
REC=$(awk -v tp="$TP" -v fn="$FN" 'BEGIN{printf "%.5f", tp/(tp+fn)}')
{
  echo "== minimap2 HiFi alignment vs GIAB HG001 v4.2.1 truth SNVs, chr20 =="
  echo "mpileup_wall_s      $(( T1 - T0 ))"
  echo "truth_snv_sites     $NTRUTH"
  echo "recovered (TP)      $TP"
  echo "missed (FN)         $FN"
  echo "truth_snv_recall    $REC  want >=0.95"
  echo ""
  echo "Recall at known sites only. Precision is not reported because genotyping exclusively"
  echo "where the truth already has a variant cannot measure false positives -- this is a check"
  echo "on whether the alignment places reads correctly, not a variant-calling benchmark."
} > truth-support.txt
cat truth-support.txt
awk -v v="$REC" 'BEGIN{exit !(v>=0.95)}'
echo 'TRUTH SUPPORT CHECK PASSED'
